# Gracie Barra Whittier

> Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy in Whittier, California, offering certified Gracie Barra instruction for kids (ages 3-15) and adults (16+). Part of the global Gracie Barra network — over 1,000 schools and 400,000+ students worldwide, with a 35+ year proven curriculum founded by Master Carlos Gracie Jr.

## Free Trial Offer

Every new student receives a **Free 3-Class Pass** — three free classes with no contract, no risk, and free uniform rental included. The trial is the same in-person experience as full membership.

## Programs

### Kids Martial Arts (ages 3-15)

- **Tiny Champions (ages 3-4)** — Playful, structured classes building coordination, focus, and confidence through BJJ-based games.
- **Little Champions 1 (ages 5-6)** — Core BJJ fundamentals through age-appropriate drills. Builds discipline, respect, and confidence.
- **Little Champions 2 (ages 7-9)** — Deeper technique focus and partner drills, continued emphasis on respect and structured practice.
- **Juniors Jiu-Jitsu (ages 10-15)** — Real BJJ technique, fitness, optional competition prep, and leadership development.

Kids program page: https://www.graciebarrawhittier.com/kids-martial-arts/

### Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (ages 16+)

- **GB1 Fundamentals** — For absolute beginners. Structured 16-week rotating curriculum covering core positions, self-defense, and foundational technique. No live sparring to start.
- **GB2 Advanced** — Live rolling, no-gi training, complex technique chains. For students who completed GB1 or train consistently.
- **GB3 Competition Program** — High-intensity drills, advanced technique, competitive sparring. Blue belts and above.

Adults program page: https://www.graciebarrawhittier.com/adults-jiu-jitsu/

## Pricing

- **First 3 classes:** Free (with free uniform rental)
- **Monthly memberships:** Typically start around $160/month, depending on program and training frequency. Family enrollment specials available.
- Final pricing is confirmed with Program Director Alex during the no-pressure post-trial conversation.

## What Makes Gracie Barra Whittier Different

- Every instructor is certified through the official Gracie Barra curriculum
- Beginner-friendly: every black belt at the academy started as a beginner
- Structured progression from total beginner to advanced practitioner
- Family-first, ego-free environment
- Real self-defense focus — BJJ works on leverage and technique, not size or strength

## Frequently Cited Questions

- **Is Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu safe for beginners?** Yes. BJJ has no striking. Fundamentals classes teach every technique slowly and with control. Injuries are rare in a well-supervised academy.
- **What should I expect in my first class?** Arrive 10 minutes early, get fitted for a free uniform rental, warm up, learn technique, practice with a partner at your level, then a brief no-pressure chat with Program Director Alex.
- **Do I need any experience?** Zero experience required. Programs are specifically designed for beginners.
- **Where is the academy?** 13595 Whittier Blvd. #104, Whittier, CA 90605.
